resources.string: "Camera settings includes capture, background mode and watermark options. Files and saving combines phone originals and watch copies. Vibration is a switch directly in the main menu. The version number is at the bottom."

"Menu buttons and switches give tactile feedback. The bezel gives short ticks when the list or slider actually moves. Vibration for actions controls all app feedback; the system touch-feedback setting also applies."

"After the watch app goes into the background, the camera session ends after one full minute without capture. Recording (including pause), a pending timer, a burst or a photo being saved prevents automatic shutdown. The minute starts again after capture finishes. Opening the watch app reconnects. File-copy jobs run separately."
